objecttypes.name: EntityType
objecttypes.description: An EntityType represents a category or class of similar entities in a data model, For example, a 'Customer' could be an EntityType with relationships to properties like name and address.

objecttypes.name: Container
objecttypes.description: A Container like a folder that holds everything inside, either by relationship "hasMember"  to objects or in a Modelview just visually keeping the objectviews.

objecttypeviews.name: Role
objecttypeviews.description: A process role defines the responsibilities and authority of individuals involved in a business process. These roles help clarify who is accountable for various tasks, ensuring efficient process management and execution.

objecttypeviews.name: Task
objecttypeviews.description: A task is a specific, defined activity or piece of work that contributes to the completion of a larger project or process.

objecttypeviews.name: View
objecttypeviews.description: A View highlight essential Information elements tailored to the need of specific users or tasks.

objecttypeviews.name: Property
objecttypeviews.description: A property is an object representing an attribute of an entity that holds basic data, such as strings, numbers, or booleans. It defines specific characteristics of the entity, like 'name' or 'age'.
